newsitem.title: UK: GRANADA'S LIDDIMENT MOVING TO UK'S ITV.
newsitem.headline: GRANADA'S LIDDIMENT MOVING TO UK'S ITV.

text.p: David Liddiment, managing director of Granada UK Broadcasting, is moving to the post of director of programmes for the UK's ITV commercial television network, ITV said on Wednesday.
Liddiment joins new ITV chief executive Richard Eyre as part of an executive management group at ITV, which represents 15 regional licence holders. Eyre has been recruited from Capital Radio Plc
Liddiment is effectively the replacement for ITV network director Marcus Plantin, who has announced he is to leave the organisation.

"Commissioning and scheduling Britain's most popular channel is the best job in British television. I am looking forward to working with Richard and his team to make sure ITV stays ahead," Liddiment said.
ITV's share of television audiences is in decline in the face of growing competition from satellite and cable channels and new terrestrial Channel 5.
It will face a growing challenge as digital technology multiplies the number of channels in the next few years.

Liddiment had been responsible for Granada's UK terrestrial sales and broadcasting activities. Granada is one of the largest ITV companies, operating licences for north-west England and London Weekend Television.
Liddiment had previously worked for the BBC as head of its entertainment group, responsible for all comedy and light entertainment shows on its two TV channels.
